objective.statement: Read 2/2, 3/2 and 4/2, and count the minim beats in a bar.
successCriteria: I know the bottom number says which note is the beat.
I can say that 2 on the bottom means a minim beat.
I can count the beats in a bar of 2/2, 3/2 or 4/2.

explanation.text: In Grade 1 the bottom number of every time signature was 4, so the beat was a crotchet. The bottom number can change: it tells you which note is worth one beat.
A bottom number of 2 means the beat is a minim. The top number still says how many beats are in each bar.

music.textAlternative: Two bars of 2/2, each with two minims.
music.questionAlternative: Bar 1: minim, minim. Bar 2: minim, minim.

explanation.caption: 2/2: two minim beats in every bar. A whole bar lasts as long as a semibreve.

music.textAlternative: Two bars of 3/2: three minims, then a semibreve and a minim.
music.questionAlternative: Bar 1: minim, minim, minim. Bar 2: semibreve, minim.

explanation.caption: 3/2: three minim beats. 4/2 is the same idea with four minim beats in a bar.

explanation.text: You may also see 2/2 written as a C with a line through it. It is called alla breve and means exactly the same as 2/2.
Top number: how many beats. Bottom number: what kind of beat. 2 means minim, 4 means crotchet.

music.textAlternative: One bar of 3/2: a minim, two crotchets and a minim.

steps: Count one beat for each minim. The first minim is beat 1.
The two crotchets share beat 2, a crotchet each for half the beat.
The last minim is beat 3. Three minim beats fill the bar of 3/2.
demonstration.textAlternative: A bar of 3/2 with a minim, two crotchets and a minim: three minim beats.
